latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the crypto-market-rank skill (version 2.0).
- Provides API access to crypto market rankings: trending tokens, top searches, Binance Alpha picks, tokenized stocks, and more.
- Includes social hype sentiment leaderboards, smart money inflow rankings, and top meme token rankings from Pulse launchpad.
- Offers a top trader PnL leaderboard and advanced filtering for targeted token or address screening.
- Supports BSC, Base, and Solana chains.
